_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Looking for Christmas lights and tree farms

annotations.title: Find Christmas light displays or tree farms near a place

description: Use this when someone asks where to see Christmas lights (drive-through or walk-through displays) or where to cut their own Christmas tree (choose-and-cut tree farms) near a US city, state or ZIP code, optionally on certain dates in the 2026 season. Choose "light_displays" or "tree_farms". Returns up to 5 results, nearest first, each with the organizer's published dates and hours (or a note that the dates are not announced yet), how it is viewed or what the farm offers, the official or visitor-bureau page we checked, the date we checked it, the date the answer stops being served and a link to our page. Dates change: always send people to the official site to confirm. Do not use this to list every display or farm, for places outside the United States, for tickets or lodging, or for Christmas markets (find_christmas_markets covers those).

end_date.description: Optional last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Date ranges are limited to 120 days.

kind.description: "light_displays" for Christmas light displays, "tree_farms" for choose-and-cut Christmas tree farms.

place.description: The place to search around: "City, ST" (for example "Edmond, OK"), a US state, or a 5-digit ZIP code. 2-60 characters. Wildcards and "all" are not accepted.

radius_miles.description: Optional search radius in miles, 5 to 250. Default 60. Ignored when the place is a whole state.

start_date.description: Optional first day you want to go, YYYY-MM-DD (2026 season). Leave out to search from today.

viewing.description: Optional, light displays only: only drive-through or only walk-through displays. Ignored for tree farms.

name: find_christmas_lights_and_tree_farms

link.description: Page on our site with details.

observed.description: Date the fact was observed or verified (YYYY-MM-DD).

title: Find Christmas light displays or tree farms near a place
